name: baton
description: Pick up and hand off work between Claude Code agents on several machines through a git message board. The baton skill (/baton [id]) shows what waits for this machine and takes it only after your go-ahead; it also covers posting plans and handovers, replying and closing. /baton also makes the session listen: new messages for this machine wake it until /baton:off; /baton:on listens again. No hooks here: `baton init` prints the Stop hook and the permission rules to add. Needs the baton CLI on PATH.
